result.instructions: Non-blocking question inbox for the human operator. Use ask_operator instead of asking the operator in chat whenever you can keep working. Ask once; the answer arrives later as a `[inbox]` message naming the Q id. After compaction call list_my_questions before asking anything. To flag something the operator should check, with no answer needed, use alert_operator.

structuredContent.message: Recorded as Q1. The operator will answer asynchronously; the answer will arrive in this conversation as a message starting with `[inbox]` that names Q1. Continue with work that does not depend on it. Do not repeat the question in chat or call ask_operator for it again. If an answer seems overdue, call check_answers.
